propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 both declare a 1,000,000 token context window, so escalation from sonnet to opus provides zero additional capacity.

A context-limit failure on sonnet retried at opus with the same window size is guaranteed to fail again at opus pricing, creating a silent no-op escalation that misleads operators into thinking even the largest model cannot fit the input.
The MODEL_LADDER declared windows are verified correct against the provider's live Models API (max_input_tokens), so the defect is in consumption logic, not in the table's accuracy.
The escalation retry loops must filter the rung ladder to skip rungs whose declared window is not strictly greater than the current rung, so only genuine capacity increases are proposed.

Both context-limit retry paths (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder) must consume a new escalation_rungs() function instead of the unfiltered models_at_or_above() to enforce the capacity-increase guarantee.
